benchmarks.name: STATS_P_VALUE_IN_UNIT_INTERVAL
benchmarks.description: A finished statistical test reports a p-value inside the unit interval.
benchmarks.ground_truth: By definition a probability; reported p-values outside [0,1] signal a broken inference.
benchmarks.citation: Wasserstein RL, Lazar NA. The ASA statement on p-values. Am Stat 70:129-133, 2016.
